harbor_adapter.notes: Five of five full oracle equivalence checks passed. This records oracle coverage only, not statistical model-agent parity. One complete run per side; SEM undefined. Task06 deterministic scores match exactly and its unchanged timing accounting is checked separately; task07 reward and deterministic outcomes match; task08/task09 full reports match. Registry publication not performed. Native baseline oracles accepted per user-reported organizer coordination on 2026-11-16.

The four-task reference-oracle parity subset has two native runs and one adapted run per task on an RTX 3080 Ti. Both task03 tasks matched the complete reward JSON and passed upstream ledger, handoff and isolation checks. Both task06 variants matched all deterministic metrics with the original timing deduction. Model training also matched model state with deterministic CUDA enabled on both sides. All 15 Task02 groups matched the native protocol Oracle across six steps each. Three representative Task02 groups also matched a live RGB-D and frozen-skill handoff probe. Registry publication is pending.
